What TKO Group says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenue and adjusted EBITDABased on performance through the first nine months of the year and our visibility into and anticipated performance for the remainder of the year, the Company is raising its guidance and now expects full year 2026 revenue of $5.790 billion to $5.830 billion and Adjusted EBITDA of $2.295 billion to $2.315 billion.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
